# orbivisor_grant (Resource)

A permission grant: a user or group gets a role on `/`, a folder (`vm:/prod`) or an object (`vm/web01`). Any change replaces the grant.

Manifest kind `Grant`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orbivisor_grant" "web_team" {
  group  = "web-team"
  role   = "operator"
  target = "vm:/prod/web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) Built-in role (admin, operator, viewer) or access role name.
- `target` (String)

### Optional

- `group` (String) Group name (or `user`).
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).
- `propagate` (Boolean) Applies below the folder (default true).
- `user` (String) User name (or `group`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).
- `name` (String) The name the server exports this object under (derived from its content).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The key is the grant itself: "user:NAME|group:NAME ROLE TARGET" (+ " no-propagate")
terraform import orbivisor_grant.web_team "group:web-team operator vm:/prod/web"
```
